metadata.description: Custom domain for this environment. Empty = deploy on the default *.azurewebsites.net hostname only (used during migration, before the DNS cutover).

true = the platform retention_sweep purges competitions past their deletion date; false = dry-run (logs only) — the kill switch. See modules/platform-function.bicep.

App role that makes a user an admin (GitHub variable ADMIN_ROLE; empty = Site.Admin), in both tenant modes. The router serves /admin/ and gates /api/manage/* on it and tells the platform via X-Forwarded-User-Admin; there is no e-mail list.

Comma-separated Entra tenant ids whose users may use the site (GitHub variable ALLOWED_TENANT_IDS). Empty = the deployment tenant only. Written to both the router (403 tenant_not_allowed for anyone else) and the platform Function App (which checks again).

Which tenant Easy Auth signs users in with (GitHub var AUTH_TENANT_MODE): workforce (default; MI federated credential) or external (the External ID tenant, no credential). external needs externalTenantId and externalClientId.
Entra External ID tenant id (GitHub var EXTERNAL_TENANT_ID). Added to the allowed tenants and handed to the platform as EXTERNAL_TENANT_IDS. Empty = not configured.
Client id of the Entra External ID app registration (GitHub var AUTH_EXTERNAL_CLIENT_ID). Used by Easy Auth in external mode.
Authority host of the external tenant (GitHub var AUTH_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_HOST), e.g. <tenantId>.ciamlogin.com.
App role an External ID identity needs to use the site (GitHub var EXTERNAL_ACCESS_ROLE). Empty = Site.Access.
Kill switch for the HOVTP listener. false = the app is still deployed but answers every request 503 (see modules/hovtp-function.bicep).
Environment the HOVTP listener reports to FS Manager.

Reverse proxies we own in front of the HOVTP listener. 3 when it is published through Front Door + WAF -> API Management (test), 0 when FS Manager posts straight at the Function App (prod, for now). See modules/hovtp-function.bicep.
Shared secret API Management injects as X-Proxy-Secret on forwarded HOVTP requests. Empty = the listener accepts direct callers (gate off).
workforce (default) or external. external needs externalTenantId and externalClientId; without them the deployment stays workforce.
Client id of the Entra External ID app registration (GitHub var AUTH_EXTERNAL_CLIENT_ID).
External tenant id (GitHub var EXTERNAL_TENANT_ID).
Authority host of the external tenant (GitHub var AUTH_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_HOST), e.g. <tenantId>.ciamlogin.com. Empty = <externalTenantId>.ciamlogin.com.
Comma-separated External ID tenant ids (EXTERNAL_TENANT_IDS) for the router, which reads the e-mail of those identities only from their email claim and requires externalAccessRole of them.
App role (EXTERNAL_ACCESS_ROLE) an External ID identity needs to use the site; without it the router sends them to /no-access/. Empty = Site.Access.
Base URL of the platform Function App (competitions registry) — the /api/* proxy target.
Base URL of the judgepapers Function App — the /judgepapers/api/* proxy target.
Base URL of the scoremodifier Function App — the /scoremodifier/api/* proxy target.

Base URL of the GDPR removal tool Function App — the /tools/gdpr/api/* proxy target.
X-Proxy-Secret the router sends to the platform Function App. Intentionally empty by default — the backend fails open when its own secret is unset.
X-Proxy-Secret the router sends to the judgepapers Function App.
X-Proxy-Secret the router sends to the scoremodifier Function App.
X-Proxy-Secret the router sends to the protocolgenerator Function App.
X-Proxy-Secret the router sends to the GDPR removal tool Function App.

App role that makes a user an admin (ADMIN_ROLE). The router serves /admin/ and proxies /api/manage/* only for identities carrying it, and tells the backends with X-Forwarded-User-Admin: 1. Empty = Site.Admin.

Comma-separated Entra tenant ids whose principals may use the APIs (ALLOWED_TENANT_IDS). Defaults to the deployment tenant; any other tenant gets 403 tenant_not_allowed from the router. Empty = nobody (fail closed).
Health URL of the HOVTP listener, probed by the admin diagnostics (HOVTP_HEALTH_URL).

Easy Auth provider segment the router's /signin redirects to (/.auth/login/<provider>). Written to the AUTH_LOGIN_PROVIDER app setting; empty means aad. Changes together with the authsettingsV2 identity provider (e.g. the move to Entra External ID).

Paths served without an Easy Auth login redirect. /health must stay open so Azure/uptime probes get a 200 instead of a 302; /judgepapers/download is the judges'-papers link e-mailed to recipients without an account (the token is checked by the judgepapers backend); /, /index.html, /signin, /landing/* and the icons, robots.txt and llms.txt make up the public landing page, which the router serves at / unless the request carries an Easy Auth session (keep in sync with LANDING_DOCUMENT_PATHS and SIGNIN_PATH in server/server.js); /assets/* holds the Vite bundles (open-source code, no data), public so the home page served at / by session cookie can always load and fall back to its sign-in view when the session has expired; /privacy (+ /*) is the privacy notice and /tietosuoja (+ /*) its Finnish translation, which everyone must be able to read before signing in; /terms (+ /*) are the terms of use, which the sign-up page links to; /fonts/* holds the self-hosted web fonts every page uses, including the public ones; /no-access and /no-access/* are the page an External ID user without the access app role is sent to (keep in sync with NO_ACCESS_PATH and PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES in server/server.js).

Shared, cross-tool readable blob container keyed by competition GUID.
Table holding both the COMPETITION rows and the CODE uniqueness rows.
Non-personal mirror of each competition deletion state, readable by the tool Function Apps.
Admin audit log and retention sweep history of the platform Function App.
User directory (e-mail, display name, first/last seen) of the platform Function App.
Identity links (tid_oid -> userId), readable by the tool Function Apps.
Competition access grants (owner/write/read per user), readable by the tool Function Apps.
Log Analytics workspace behind ai-fs-platform (log-fs-platform-<env>).
Days the technical logs are kept (workspace and App Insights). The privacy notice promises 90.
Shared blob container the registry writes competition data into.
true = retention_sweep purges expired competitions; false = dry-run logging only.
Table the platform mirrors each competition retention state into for the tools.
Table for the admin audit log and the retention sweep history.
Table of the user directory (PII; this app only).

The value the HOVTP listener gets for HOVTP_ENABLED.
Grant Storage Blob Delegator (user-delegation SAS for downloads). Kept switchable: only an identity that actually mints download SAS needs it.
The listener OWN storage account: AzureWebJobsStorage host state + its one-deploy package container. NOT the platform account.
The PLATFORM storage account holding `competition-data` and the `competitions` table. Passed to the app as COMPETITION_DATA_ACCOUNT because AzureWebJobsStorage no longer points at it.
Connection string of the shared ai-fs-platform Application Insights component.
Shared blob container the listener writes competition data into.
Kill switch. false = every HOVTP request is answered 503 without touching storage. Bicep-owned, so it survives a redeploy.
Environment echoed in X-HOVTP-Environment and matched against the sender.
true = a serial-number gap is refused with 450 Out Of Synchro instead of accepted with a warning.
Value advertised in X-HOVTP-Keep-Alive-Interval (seconds).

Number of trusted proxy hops in front of the app; the client IP is taken that many entries back from the end of X-Forwarded-For. 0 = App Service only (direct *.azurewebsites.net). 3 = behind Front Door + WAF -> API Management, which add three entries in front of the socket peer.

Value API Management injects as X-Proxy-Secret on every forwarded request. Empty = the gate is OFF and the app accepts direct callers (local dev, and any environment not published through Front Door/APIM yet). Set it and POST/OPTIONS without the header are 403 — this, not an IP allow-list, is what makes hop counting trustworthy, because APIM Basic v2 outbound IPs are not guaranteed static.
Comma-separated ODF DocumentTypes that are stored. Everything else is logged and dropped with a 200.
Shared blob container the listener writes competition files into.
Table holding the platform CODE/COMPETITION rows and the listener own HOVTPSESSION/HOVTPSOURCE rows.
Shared blob container holding the per-competition file pool.
Table holding the platform retention clock (DeletionDate / Status / PurgedUtc only).
Table linking sign-in identities (tid_oid) to platform user ids.
